recipe_target.name: recipe_target
recipe_target.value: ("recipes"."kind" = 'product' and "recipes"."product_id" is not null and "recipes"."output_ingredient_id" is null) or ("recipes"."kind" = 'preparation' and "recipes"."product_id" is null and "recipes"."output_ingredient_id" is not null)

production_cost_valid.name: production_cost_valid
production_cost_valid.value: ("production_batches"."total_cost" is null or "production_batches"."total_cost" >= 0) and ("production_batches"."unit_cost" is null or "production_batches"."unit_cost" >= 0)

production_selection_quantity.name: production_selection_quantity
production_selection_quantity.value: ("production_selections"."option_id" is null and "production_selections"."quantity" = 0) or ("production_selections"."option_id" is not null and "production_selections"."quantity" > 0)

table_grid_bounds.name: table_grid_bounds
table_grid_bounds.value: "dining_tables"."x" between 0 and 5 and "dining_tables"."y" between 0 and 5 and "dining_tables"."capacity" between 1 and 30

sale_line_values.name: sale_line_values
sale_line_values.value: "sale_lines"."quantity" between 1 and 999 and "sale_lines"."unit_price" >= 0 and "sale_lines"."line_total" = "sale_lines"."unit_price" * "sale_lines"."quantity" and ("sale_lines"."list_price" is null or "sale_lines"."list_price" >= 0)

sale_payment_collector.name: sale_payment_collector
sale_payment_collector.value: ("sale_payments"."collector" = 'local' and "sale_payments"."method_id" is not null) or ("sale_payments"."collector" = 'platform' and "sale_payments"."method_id" is null)

sale_payment_kind.name: sale_payment_kind
sale_payment_kind.value: ("sale_payments"."kind" = 'collection' and "sale_payments"."original_payment_id" is null) or ("sale_payments"."kind" = 'refund' and "sale_payments"."original_payment_id" is not null)

sale_channel.name: sale_channel
sale_channel.value: ("sales"."origin" = 'delivery' and "sales"."channel" in ('pedidosya','ubereats') and "sales"."external_id" is not null and "sales"."fulfillment" in ('delivery','pickup') and "sales"."table_id" is null) or ("sales"."origin" in ('counter','table') and "sales"."channel" = 'counter' and "sales"."external_id" is null and "sales"."fulfillment" in ('takeaway','dine_in'))
